correctness.rationale: The discriminant reduction has q-to-one fibers; linear sums are zero, all six quadratic cross-sums are −1, odd cubic terms cancel because χ(−1)=−1, and an explicit invertible projective matrix multiplies the quartic homogeneous form by a nonsquare. The quartic affine character sum is therefore −1. The boundary correction is 0 or 8, fixed by integrality, and gives the stated floor function. Symbolic factorization and exhaustive exact tests over 26 prime/prime-power fields independently confirmed critical steps; these finite checks are not the general proof.
